source: Written 2026-10-15 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-15), printed power/toughness from the same sheet (it gives none for Giada, Righteous Valkyrie, Youthful Valkyrie, Serra's Emissary or Archangel of Tithes, so no scene states theirs), Scryfall rulings, and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. Counter math: Giada counts every Angel you already control, herself included, never the one entering (Giada ruling); separate token triggers go on the stack in the order you choose (CR 603.3b) and resolve one at a time, so each token sees the ones before it. Entering with counters counts as putting them on, and its controller puts them (CR 122.6, 122.6a; the same reading as the Fathom Mage and Simic Ascendancy rulings): that is why Exemplar of Light draws. Righteous Valkyrie reads toughness as its trigger resolves (ruling). Commander starting life is 40 (CR 903.7): Righteous Valkyrie's bar is 47, Angel of Destiny's 55, and Angel of Destiny must still be on the battlefield at your end step (ruling). End-step token makers check as the end step begins (CR 603.4; Angelic Accord ruling), so life gained during the end step makes no token that turn. Protection from creatures (CR 702.16b, 702.16e, 702.16f); indestructible (CR 702.12b); double strike's second damage step (CR 702.4b); attackers tap unless they have vigilance (CR 508.1f, 702.20b) and untap only in their controller's untap step (CR 502.3). The Book of Exalted Deeds' Angel keeps its ability without the counter (ruling).

scenes.head: Giada, Font of Hope — Choir of Wings
scenes.sub: Mono-white Angels. Every Angel after her enters with extra +1/+1 counters, and the life you gain turns into more Angels.
scenes.say: Giada, Font of Hope. Choir of Wings. Mono-white Angels: every Angel after her enters with extra plus-one counters, and the life you gain turns into more Angels.

scenes.head: Two mana, three lines
scenes.sub: Flying, vigilance. Each other Angel you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter for each Angel you already control. She taps for {W} to cast Angels.
scenes.say: Giada costs two mana, one of it white. Flying and vigilance. Each other Angel you control enters with an additional plus-one counter for each Angel you already control. And she taps for one white mana, spent only on Angel spells.

scenes.head: Plan one: a flying army that grows
scenes.sub: 31 Angels in the 99, and Angel tokens count too. Cast the cheap ones first: every Angel after them enters bigger.
scenes.say: Plan one: a flying army that grows. There are thirty-one Angels in the ninety-nine, and Angel tokens count too. Cast the cheap ones first, and every Angel after them enters bigger.

scenes.head: Plan two: life becomes Angels
scenes.sub: [[Bishop of Wings]] gains you 4 life whenever an Angel you control enters. Four cards turn a turn's life gain into an Angel token at end step.
scenes.say: Plan two: life becomes Angels. Bishop of Wings gains you four life whenever an Angel you control enters. And four cards turn the life you gained that turn into an Angel token at end step.

scenes.head: Plan three: two ways to end it
scenes.sub: Swing with a wide flying board, or be at 55 life at your end step: [[Angel of Destiny]] makes each player it attacked that turn lose.
scenes.say: Plan three: two ways to end it. Swing with a wide flying board, or be at fifty-five life at your end step, and Angel of Destiny makes each player it attacked that turn lose the game.

scenes.head: Protect the board
scenes.sub: [[Flawless Maneuver]] is free while you control a commander, and it makes your creatures indestructible until end of turn. Hold it for the wrath.
scenes.say: Protect the board. Flawless Maneuver is free while you control a commander, and it makes your creatures indestructible until end of turn. Hold it for the wrath.

scenes.head: Bigger Angels. More life. More Angels.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: the counter engine, life into Angels, protecting the board, and how it wins.
scenes.say: Bigger Angels. More life. More Angels. Four clips follow: the counter engine, life into Angels, protecting the board, and how the deck wins.

scenes.head: Count the Angels you already control
scenes.sub: Giada counts. The Angel entering doesn't count itself. That's how many extra +1/+1 counters it enters with, tokens included.
scenes.say: Count the Angels you already control. Giada counts, and the Angel that's entering doesn't count itself. That's how many extra plus-one counters it enters with, and Angel tokens get them too.

scenes.head: Turn 2: Giada
scenes.sub: Two [[Plains]] pay her {1}{W}.
scenes.say: Turn two: Giada, paid with two Plains.

scenes.head: Turn 3: [[Exemplar of Light]] for four
scenes.sub: Three Plains plus Giada's {W}, which only casts Angels. One Angel already here: one counter, a 4/4, and Exemplar draws a card.
scenes.say: Turn three: Exemplar of Light, for four. Three Plains, plus Giada's white mana, which only casts Angels. Giada is already here, so Exemplar enters with one counter: a four-four. Entering with a counter counts as putting one on it, so Exemplar draws a card.

scenes.head: Turn 4: the cheaper Angel first
scenes.sub: [[Youthful Valkyrie]] for two sees two Angels: two counters. And she takes another counter from every Angel that enters after her.
scenes.say: Turn four: the cheaper Angel first. Youthful Valkyrie costs two and sees two Angels, so she enters with two counters. And she takes another counter from every Angel you control that enters after her.

scenes.head: Then [[Inspiring Overseer]]: three counters
scenes.sub: Three Angels already here: the 2/1 enters as a 5/4. You gain 1 life and draw a card. Youthful Valkyrie takes her third counter.
scenes.say: Then Inspiring Overseer, for three. Three Angels are already here, so the two-one enters as a five-four. You gain one life and draw a card, and Youthful Valkyrie takes her third counter.

scenes.head: That 1 life grows [[Exemplar of Light|Exemplar]]
scenes.sub: Whenever you gain life, it gets a +1/+1 counter, and putting counters on it draws a card, once each turn. Now a 5/5.
scenes.say: That one life grows Exemplar. Whenever you gain life, it gets a plus-one counter, and putting counters on it draws a card, once each turn. It's a five-five now.

scenes.head: Tokens count too
scenes.sub: [[Serra the Benevolent|Serra]]'s −3 makes a 4/4 Angel. Four Angels already here: it enters as an 8/8. [[Court of Grace]] makes a 4/4 flier each upkeep while you're the monarch.
scenes.say: Tokens count too. Serra's minus three makes a four-four Angel with flying and vigilance. Four Angels are already here, so it enters as an eight-eight. Court of Grace makes a four-four flying Angel every upkeep while you're the monarch.

scenes.head: Order matters
scenes.sub: Each Angel counts only the Angels already here. Cast your cheap Angels early, and every big one after them arrives bigger.
scenes.say: Order matters. Each Angel counts only the Angels already here. Cast your cheap Angels early, and every big one after them arrives bigger.

scenes.head: [[Bishop of Wings]]: 4 life per Angel
scenes.sub: Whenever an Angel you control enters, gain 4 life. When one dies, a 1/1 white Spirit with flying.
scenes.say: Bishop of Wings: four life per Angel. Whenever an Angel you control enters, you gain four life. Whenever one dies, you create a one-one white Spirit with flying.

scenes.head: [[Righteous Valkyrie]]: its toughness in life
scenes.sub: Whenever another Angel or Cleric you control enters, gain life equal to its toughness, Giada's counters included. At 47 or more, your creatures get +2/+2.
scenes.say: Righteous Valkyrie: life equal to toughness. Whenever another Angel or Cleric you control enters, you gain life equal to its toughness, Giada's counters included. And at forty-seven life or more, seven over Commander's starting forty, your creatures get plus two plus two.

scenes.head: [[The Wind Crystal]] doubles it all
scenes.sub: If you'd gain life, you gain twice that much instead. Each Bishop trigger becomes 8. White spells cost {1} less.
scenes.say: The Wind Crystal doubles it all. If you would gain life, you gain twice that much instead, so each Bishop trigger becomes eight. And your white spells cost one less.

scenes.head: Four cards turn that life into Angels
scenes.sub: [[Angelic Accord]] and [[Valkyrie Harbinger]]: at each end step, if you gained 4 or more life this turn, a 4/4 flying Angel.
scenes.say: Four cards turn that life into Angels. Angelic Accord and Valkyrie Harbinger: at the beginning of each end step, if you gained four or more life this turn, a four-four flying Angel. Harbinger's has vigilance too.

scenes.head: Two more token makers
scenes.sub: [[The Book of Exalted Deeds|The Book]]: 3 or more life, a 3/3 at your end step. [[Ob Nixilis, the Ascended|Ob Nixilis]]: any life this turn, a 4/4 at each end step, opponents' turns too.
scenes.say: Two more token makers. The Book of Exalted Deeds: three or more life, and a three-three Angel at your end step. Ob Nixilis, the Ascended: any life gained this turn, and a four-four Angel at each end step, opponents' turns included.

scenes.head: Turn 6: [[Valkyrie Harbinger]]
scenes.sub: Bishop and [[Angelic Accord]] are out. Harbinger sees one Angel, Giada: one counter, a 5/6. Bishop gains you 4: both end-step triggers are on.
scenes.say: Turn six: Valkyrie Harbinger. Bishop of Wings and Angelic Accord are already out. Harbinger sees one Angel, Giada, so it enters with one counter: a five-six. Bishop gains you four life, and that turns on both end-step triggers.

scenes.head: End step: two Angels, one at a time
scenes.sub: You order the triggers. The first 4/4 sees two Angels: a 6/6. The second sees three: a 7/7. Bishop gains 4 for each.
scenes.say: End step: two Angels, one at a time. You choose the order of your triggers. The first four-four sees two Angels and enters as a six-six. The second sees three: a seven-seven. Bishop gains you four life for each.

scenes.head: Late life still counts
scenes.sub: The tokens' 8 life came after the end step began: it makes no token this turn, but counts toward [[Righteous Valkyrie]]'s 47 and [[Angel of Destiny]]'s 55.
scenes.say: Late life still counts. The tokens' eight life came after the end step began, so it makes no token this turn. But it counts toward Righteous Valkyrie's forty-seven and Angel of Destiny's fifty-five.

scenes.head: [[Flawless Maneuver]]: free with Giada out
scenes.sub: If you control a commander, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
scenes.say: Flawless Maneuver: free with Giada out. If you control a commander, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.

scenes.head: Their wrath destroys nothing
scenes.sub: An indestructible permanent can't be destroyed, by a destroy effect or by lethal damage. It doesn't stop exile.
scenes.say: Their wrath destroys nothing. An indestructible permanent can't be destroyed, whether by a destroy effect or by lethal damage. It doesn't stop exile, though.

scenes.head: [[Avacyn, Angel of Hope|Avacyn]]: indestructible every turn
scenes.sub: An 8/8 with flying, vigilance and indestructible, and every other permanent you control has indestructible too. [[Sephara, Sky's Blade|Sephara]] gives it to your other fliers.
scenes.say: Avacyn, Angel of Hope: indestructible every turn. She's an eight-eight with flying, vigilance and indestructible, and every other permanent you control has indestructible too. Sephara, Sky's Blade gives it to your other creatures with flying.

scenes.head: [[Serra's Emissary]]: choose creature
scenes.sub: You and your creatures get protection from creatures: yours can't be blocked, creature damage to you or them is prevented, and creatures' abilities can't target either.
scenes.say: Serra's Emissary: choose creature as it enters. You and your creatures get protection from creatures. Your attackers can't be blocked, damage from creatures to you or your creatures is prevented, and creatures' abilities can't target you or them.

scenes.head: [[Ob Nixilis, the Ascended|Ob Nixilis]] punishes their attack
scenes.sub: Creatures that attacked stay tapped until their controller's next untap step. Cast him on your turn: he destroys every tapped creature your opponents control.
scenes.say: Ob Nixilis punishes their attack. Creatures that attacked stay tapped until their controller's next untap step, unless they have vigilance. Cast Ob Nixilis on your turn, and he destroys every tapped creature your opponents control.

scenes.head: Three destroyed, 3 life, one more Angel
scenes.sub: You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed. That life means Ob Nixilis makes a 4/4 Angel at your end step.
scenes.say: Three destroyed, three life, and one more Angel. You gain one life for each creature destroyed this way, and gaining any life this turn means Ob Nixilis makes a four-four Angel at your end step.

scenes.head: Make attacking you expensive
scenes.sub: [[Ghostly Prison]]: {2} for each creature attacking you. [[Archangel of Tithes]], while untapped: {1} more each. [[Linvala, Keeper of Silence|Linvala]]: their creatures' activated abilities can't be activated.
scenes.say: Make attacking you expensive. Ghostly Prison: two mana for each creature attacking you. Archangel of Tithes, while it's untapped: one more for each. And Linvala, Keeper of Silence: activated abilities of their creatures can't be activated.

scenes.head: Answers in white
scenes.sub: [[Swords to Plowshares]] and [[Path to Exile]] exile a creature for {W}. [[Heliod's Intervention]] destroys X artifacts or enchantments, or a player gains twice X life.
scenes.say: Answers in white. Swords to Plowshares and Path to Exile each exile a creature for one white mana. Heliod's Intervention destroys X artifacts or enchantments, or makes a player gain twice X life.

scenes.head: [[Angel of Destiny]]
scenes.sub: A 2/6 flier with double strike. Whenever one of your creatures deals combat damage to a player, you and that player each gain that much life.
scenes.say: Angel of Destiny. A two-six with flying and double strike. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you and that player each gain that much life.

scenes.head: Commander starts at 40, so the bar is 55
scenes.sub: At your end step, with at least 15 life over your starting total, each player it attacked this turn loses. It must still be on the battlefield.
scenes.say: Commander starts you at forty life, so the bar is fifty-five. At the beginning of your end step, if you have at least fifteen life more than your starting total, each player Angel of Destiny attacked this turn loses the game. It has to still be on the battlefield then.

scenes.head: You're at 48. Destiny attacks as a 4/8
scenes.sub: It entered with two counters: Giada and an Angel token were already here. Unblocked, double strike deals 4, then 4 more.
scenes.say: You're at forty-eight. Angel of Destiny attacks as a four-eight: it entered with two counters, because Giada and an Angel token were already here. Unblocked, double strike deals four damage, then four more.

scenes.head: Each hit gains you 4: 56 life
scenes.sub: That's 56: past 55. They gain each hit back too, so their life doesn't move. At your end step, they lose.
scenes.say: Each hit gains you four: fifty-six life, past fifty-five. They gain each hit back too, so their life total doesn't move. At your end step, they lose the game.

scenes.head: Or fly over them
scenes.sub: At 47+ life, [[Righteous Valkyrie]] gives your creatures +2/+2. [[Lyra Dawnbringer|Lyra]] gives your other Angels +1/+1 and lifelink. Every Angel token came in with Giada's counters.
scenes.say: Or just fly over them. At forty-seven life or more, Righteous Valkyrie gives your creatures plus two plus two. Lyra gives your other Angels plus one plus one and lifelink. And every Angel token came in with Giada's counters.

scenes.head: [[Enlightened Tutor]] finds the missing piece
scenes.sub: An instant for {W}: put an artifact or enchantment from your library on top, like [[The Wind Crystal]], [[Angelic Accord]] or [[The Book of Exalted Deeds|the Book]].
scenes.say: Enlightened Tutor finds the missing piece. For one white mana, at instant speed, it puts an artifact or enchantment from your library on top: The Wind Crystal, Angelic Accord, or The Book of Exalted Deeds.

scenes.head: [[The Book of Exalted Deeds|The Book]]: you can't lose
scenes.sub: {W}{W}{W}, tap and exile it, as a sorcery: an Angel gains "You can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game."
scenes.say: The Book of Exalted Deeds: you can't lose. Pay three white, tap it and exile it, at sorcery speed, and an Angel gains: you can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game. Give it to an indestructible Angel like [[Avacyn, Angel of Hope|Avacyn]].

scenes.head: Giada, Font of Hope
scenes.sub: Bracket 3 · bigger Angels, more life, more Angels · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Giada, Font of Hope. Bracket three. Bigger Angels, more life, more Angels. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
